notes.title: The hunt begins – Ravenhille is out now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
After 2 years of developing this indie horror hunting game, I can finally say that it’s officially out on Steam!
The game was developed using the Godot engine. This project has been fun, challenging, and motivating It gave me something to look forward to every single day.

I’ve always dreamed of releasing a game on Steam. I worked on Ravenhille every day after school, constantly learning and experimenting to bring more life into the game.

I don’t consider it "finished" - not yet. I plan to keep working on it: adding animations, models, AI-s, and effects to make it even more immersive.


About the game 🕯️
Ravenhille is a horror hunting game set in a cursed village and a dark, haunting forest.
You play as a well-known hunter tasked with tracking down a mythical beast that roams the woods and terrorizes the locals. But beware - there are more secrets hidden beneath the surface...

🎯 Features:

Hand-crafted environments

Twisted and deep lore

Financial system

Skill system

Non-linear gameplay

Challenging difficulty

Crafting

Looting-system


What’s next? 🔧
I plan to continue development with more updates and improvements.


Your feedback means everything 💙
I want to involve the community and players in shaping Ravenhille into its best form. If you have feedback, ideas, or just want to share your thoughts - I’m listening.


One last thing...
This game was made entirely by one person.
I worked on it for 2 years, driven by passion and a dream. If you decide to check out Ravenhille, play it, and maybe even leave a review - it would truly mean the world to me.

Thank you so much!

QuantumPixel

What will be next?

Steam Next Fest is around the corner, so I do not have much time left. I've gathered all my thoughts and keep improving the demo, hoping I can gain more wishlists and players.

In the coming months, I’ll be focusing on expanding the world, adding deeper lore, and making sure the player experience is great. There's so much more to uncover in the forest, and trust me - things are only going to get darker from here.

Thank you for joining me on this journey. Stay sharp, keep your lanterns lit, and remember:

The hunters came before. They did not return.

See you in Ravenhille.

notes.title: Echoes of the Deep Update
notes.content:
🩸 Ravenhille Update – "Echoes of the Deep"
The curse spreads. New creatures roam the forest. Something stirs beneath the ground...
This update brings new dangers, secrets, and tools to survive the horrors of Ravenhill.

Patch Notes:

More monsters (dog, spider, blob)

!SUMMON A DEMON BY YOURSELF NOW!

Monster spawner system

New caves and puzzles

Map rework (access it from the quick menu – Key: Q), includes a mini player marker and the ability to place pins. Further improvements are planned

New items

New villager: Medic – he can heal you (find him in the forest)

New start screen

More models

More optimizations

More UI improvements

More animations

More bug fixes
